Strategy: Mean-threshold penalty: score by tightest fit but subtract a large penalty from every bin whose residual exceeds the mean of the feasible residuals, so items concentrate in below-average bins and above-average bins stay available for large items. It can fail when above-average bins are the only good fits and the penalty forces wasteful detours.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    m = sum(bins) / len(bins)
    return [(-(r - item) - (500.0 if r > m else 0.0)) for r in bins]
```
